# PhD students


```{r, echo=FALSE}
phd <- c("Boubacar Diallo"  ,"2025 - 2027","Clustering for the detection of homogeneous acoustic landscapes", "co-supervised with Ndèye Niang and Vincent Audigier")

tab <- matrix(phd,nrow = length(phd)/4,ncol=4,dimnames = list(NULL,c("Student", "Duration", "Research topic", "Supervisers")),byrow=TRUE)
#kbl(tab)%>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"))
kbl(tab,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l","c","l")) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("hover", "striped"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left",
    font_size = 15
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "8cm")
```

# Internships

```{r, echo=FALSE}
stagiaire <- c(
  "Sabin Bohissou", "M2","6 months","2026","Supervised classification for spatial functional data",
  "Roger Kouacou",  "M2","5 months","2026","Statistical and data mining methods applied to the Tactile Game video game platform",
  "Lancelot Dallain, Tanguy Cesar", "M2","5 weeks","2026","Clustering of functional data with applications in oceanography",
  "Pierre Chambet", "M2","5 weeks","2026","Clustering of hybrid data",
  "Hugo Nguyen", "M2", "5 weeks","2025","Clustering for the detection of homogeneous acoustic landscapes",
  "Djafarou Oulare","M2", "5 months", "2024", "Clustering for the detection of homogeneous acoustic landscapes",
  "Marcellin Djohoundjo", "M2", "6 months", "2024", "Nonparametric prediction for object geo-localization",
  "Koffi Amezouwui","M2",      "6 months","2023","Multiple imputation using non-parametric regression"
)
tab <- matrix(stagiaire,nrow = length(stagiaire)/5,ncol=5,dimnames = list(NULL,c("Intern","Level", "Duration", "Year", "Research topic")),byrow=TRUE)
#kbl(tab)%>% kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) %>% column_spec(1, bold = TRUE)
kbl(tab,
    booktabs = TRUE,
    align = c("l","c","c","l")) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("hover", "striped"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left",
    font_size = 15
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "4cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "2.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(3, width = "2.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(4, width = "2cm")
```
